Final green head for L1 and same-head contract review (2026-11-25T10:53Z): `8acc3c0e7f9c37c9145aa2bca36e55cf48d37c21`.

- **Checks at this head:** 45 `success`, 13 expected skips, 0 failed, 0 pending. `mergeable_state: clean`.
- **Size:** 4 files; no governed path; `Fixes #36410`, since item 2 is the card's last open item (item 1 landed in #36878). `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **What it does:** `@object-ui/components` `NavigationOverlay` no longer declares, destructures or passes on its `comments` prop. The premise was measured: none of the 27 render sites under `ui/`, `examples/`, `packages/` and `apps/` passes it. `RecordTopBar`'s own `comments` slot is kept, because `RecordDetailView` still fills it on the phone and the desktop page bar.
- **Changeset:** written like the `NavigationOverlayProps.maximizable` removal. It carries a patch level, a BREAKING banner, the ADR-0087 `not-required (runtime-export-retired) @object-ui/components#NavigationOverlayProps.comments` marker (which `check-adr-0087-registration` verified) and one FROM-TO line.
- **Evidence:**
  - Type pin: an `@ts-expect-error` pin plus a render check. Putting the prop back fails `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` with TS2578, and the file was restored to the HEAD blob.
  - Tests: components 4967 passed; type-check exit 0.
  - Gates: 38 of 38 derived exit 0.
  - Dogfood battery: green.
- **Deviation:** the first push was refused by the pre-push hook for a card-reference line in the commit message. The unpushed commit was reworded and pushed through the overlap gate; no override was used. The seat accepted this.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8acc3c0e7f9c37c9145aa2bca36e55cf48d37c21`
Local-runs: probe — re-ran the type pin's revert in a throwaway worktree (`tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` in `ui/packages/components`, at head and with `comments?: React.ReactNode;` put back), because the brief asked for the TS2578 reading to be reproduced
Scope: .changeset/36410-navigation-overlay-comments-prop.md, ui/packages/components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx, ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/navigation-overlay-bar-26679.test.tsx, ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/record-top-bar-comments-36075.test.tsx + ui/packages/components/src/custom/record-top-bar.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx, packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts, scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs, docs/adr/0087 (read in the cited code, outside the diff)

Face: narrowing (`record-recognisers --template --paths` refused the four paths as deciding no face and pointed at the changeset's `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` line; `--face narrowing` maps to this tier).

### ① Derived judgments

- Zero consumers holds. A scan of every `NavigationOverlay` opening tag at head finds 30 JSX sites and one `h(NavigationOverlay, …)` in `ui/e2e/toast-under-modal.spec.ts`; none names `comments`. All sites are under `ui/`; `examples/`, `apps/`, `packages/` (outside CHANGELOG and spec jsdoc prose) and `skills/` render none.
- The spread sites carry no `comments`: `useNavigationOverlay.ts` has no such word, ObjectGrid's `recordOverlayShellProps` is `storageKey`, `legacyStorageKey`, `width`, and the test harnesses spread a `Partial` of the props type, which the compiler now checks.
- `NavigationOverlay` has no rest spread, so a stray `comments` from an untyped host is dropped and reaches no DOM node.
- No authorable path: `NavigationOverlay` is exported from `custom/index.ts` and registered as no node type; `NavigationConfigSchema` (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`) is a strict object with no `comments` key. A metadata author cannot set it, so `Metadata-protocol: none` is true and no narrowing of the metadata protocol happens.
- No skill, docs page or README names the drawer's `comments` prop (the `plugin-detail` README example passes none). `Skills-docs: none` is true.
- History agrees with the prose: the prop came in with #36114 (card #36075) and its only caller left with #36406 (`8466fcad2e0`).
- Type pin: at head the test project compiles the pin file clean; with the declaration put back (blob `a7cb247c` to `dbcac407`, the same pair the dev reports) it fails with `navigation-overlay-bar-26679.test.tsx(129,5): error TS2578: Unused '@ts-expect-error' directive.` File restored to `a7cb247c`, worktree removed. The only other line in both runs is an environment one (`../cli/src/commands/generate.ts` cannot find `chalk`, from the borrowed `node_modules`).
- Check-runs on the head: 45 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed, including Check Changeset, Type Check UI, Test UI 1 to 16, Dogfood Regression Gate and Governed Surface Queue Guard.
- K = 8 against `origin/main` `f9fda2a4f84`; merge base `9171bed0a65`. `git merge-tree --write-tree` is clean (tree `bf9dab19832`). Main's eight commits touch `use-horizontal-overflow.ts` and two other test files in the package, and none of the four paths.

### ② Semver level

- `@object-ui/components: patch` is right: AGENTS.md gives `patch` to a `Metadata-protocol: none` change, breaking or not, with the BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition kept. The `maximizable` precedent (`.changeset/35854-one-way-to-open-a-record.md`, #35910) was `minor` only because that changeset also declared `Metadata-protocol: semantic`.
- `runtime-export-retired` is the right category. It is in the gate's category list (`scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`), ADR-0087 documents the `PACKAGE#Type.member` operand form used here, and it stays open on a declared narrowing where `no-migration-prescription` is refused. The marker's wording matches the precedent word for word apart from the operand.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flag, pre-push hook refused a commit message with a card-number line and the commit was reworded: the pushed commit has no such line and CI's PR-body guards pass. Whether a bypass was used cannot be read from the remote; nothing contradicts the note.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, no data path in the diff.
- No `open_questions` entry.

### ④ Design judgment

- The narrowing takes away a capability no consumer in the tree uses and that the product already withdrew (#36406). `RecordTopBar.comments` stays and is filled at `RecordDetailView.tsx:5935` (phone) and `:5948` (desktop), as the changeset says.
- Changeset, sentence by sentence: the banner, the history sentence, the "RecordTopBar keeps its own slot" sentence and the FROM-TO line are each true against the code. The fix (delete `comments`; the full page's bar draws the switch) is the complete migration for a typed host.
- 维护者速读: all four lines are true. "用户无感" holds because no caller fills the slot; "编译报错" holds for a typed host (an untyped one has the prop dropped silently, which the BREAKING banner covers); "可直接撤回" holds, the diff is three removals.
- N1 — The PR body says 27 render sites; the scan finds 31 (30 JSX, one `h()`), plus a docblock example at `navigation-overlay.tsx:63`. The count is off; the zero is not.
- N2 — The FROM-TO fix names the product answer only. A host that still wants its own switch in the drawer has the surviving `toggles` slot; leaving it unnamed follows the #36406 ruling.
- N3 — The render half of the new test was not re-run here (vitest could not start in the throwaway worktree). By reading, it goes red on a full revert: `renderBar` spreads its props and the old code handed `comments` to `RecordTopBar`, which draws it. CI's Test UI passed at this head.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-36410-overlay-comments-slot`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ`

**VERDICT: PASS**

No must-fix, no should-fix.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `8acc3c0e7f9c37c9145aa2bca36e55cf48d37c21` · 2026-11-25T11:01Z

- Card #36410 item 2 (item 1 landed in #36878): `NavigationOverlay` in `@object-ui/components` loses its `comments` prop. Four files, +35/-11: the changeset, the component, one new pin test, one docblock.
- Zero consumers confirmed at head: 30 JSX sites and one `h()` call in the e2e harness, none passing `comments`; the spread sources (`useNavigationOverlay`, ObjectGrid's `recordOverlayShellProps`) carry none. Nothing in `examples/`, `apps/`, `packages/`, `skills/` or `content/docs/` renders or documents it.
- Not authorable: the component is registered as no node type and `NavigationConfigSchema` is a strict object without `comments`, so `Metadata-protocol: none` and `patch` are right.
- ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (runtime-export-retired @object-ui/components#NavigationOverlayProps.comments)` is a listed gate category in the documented `Type.member` form, and matches the `maximizable` precedent (`.changeset/35854-one-way-to-open-a-record.md`, #35910).
- FROM-TO line is true and complete: `RecordTopBar.comments` stays and `RecordDetailView.tsx` fills it at `:5935` (phone) and `:5948` (desktop). The changeset and 维护者速读 read true line by line.
- Type pin reproduced: with `comments?: React.ReactNode;` put back, `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` fails with `navigation-overlay-bar-26679.test.tsx(129,5): error TS2578`; clean at head. Same blobs as the dev reports (`a7cb247c`, `dbcac407`).
- Check-runs on the head: 45 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed. K = 8 against main `f9fda2a4f84`; `git merge-tree` is clean and main's eight commits touch none of the four paths.
- Dev's note on the pre-push hook: the pushed commit has no card-number line; nothing contradicts "no bypass", and the remote cannot prove it.
- N1 — The PR body says 27 render sites; the scan finds 31. The zero holds.
- N2 — The fix line does not name the surviving `toggles` slot for a host that wants its own switch in the drawer; that follows the #36406 ruling.
- N3 — The render half of the pin was judged by reading plus CI's Test UI, not re-run here.
- The PR is still a draft; the zone marks it ready before landing.
- Contract review at the same head is in the `## Contract review` record: PASS.
- Landing: the zone lands it after measuring K; if K ≥ 15 it merges main first; a merge-only head move keeps this ACCEPT.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感。记录侧边抽屉组件（`NavigationOverlay`）删掉了一个评论按钮参数。全仓 31 处用到这个组件，没有一处传这个参数；应用作者也无法通过页面元数据设置它。
- 为什么做：「评论通知直达评论」（#36410）的第二项清理。第一项已在 #36878 合并。
- 出错会怎样：只有自己写代码、并且给这个组件传了评论参数的集成方会编译报错，删掉该参数即可。发布说明里写了破坏性改动说明和迁移写法。可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：审核并合并。它删掉了一个已发布的组件参数，属于声明了收窄的改动，按 2026-11-19 的裁定要你批准，合并队列的治理门禁也因此把它退了出来。契约审核 PASS：7160478947，Head-sha `8acc3c0e7f9c37c9145aa2bca36e55cf48d37c21`。席位核对 ACCEPT：7160490369。0 个失败检查。

席位意见：通过。没有使用方，组件不可通过元数据配置，`Metadata-protocol: none` 和 patch 都对。破坏性说明照之前删 `maximizable` 的先例写。剩 3 处小瑕疵，比如正文写的是 27 处，实际是 31 处，不影响合并。
